summary.text: Ed Diehl is a Republican member of the Oregon House of Representatives for House District 17, a seat his biography says he has held since 2023.
Before entering the legislature he was president and co-founder of Concept Systems, Inc.

paragraphs.text: Diehl was born and raised in Plains, Montana, and has lived in Oregon since 1989, according to his biography.
He earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Stanford University in 1987 and a master's in mechanical engineering and smart product design there in 1989.
He was president and co-founder of Concept Systems, Inc., from 1999 to 2018.
Diehl and his wife, Jamie, have lived in Scio since 1997 and raised two children in the North Santiam School District.

His community involvement includes the Santiam Hospital board of directors since 2017, the Catholic Community Services Foundation board since 2020, the Santiam Canyon Long Term Recovery Group leadership board from 2021 to 2022, and the Knights of Columbus.
He is an instrument-rated private pilot.
